name: shader-simplex-noise
title: Simplex Noise
description: A smooth simplex-noise flow field drifts through your palette in soft bands, drawn in WebGL.
useWhen: You want the smoothest of the noise backdrops, with fewer directional artifacts than Perlin.
A clean, minimal scene needs gentle multi-stop color drift.
You want posterized banding control via `steps_per_color`.
avoidWhen: You want cloudier, softer fog: use shader-perlin-noise.
You want cellular structure: use shader-voronoi.
You want neural-web filaments: use shader-neuro-noise.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: How fast it moves. 0 holds still.

variables.label: Colors
variables.description: Up to 10 colors, comma separated, the noise moves through.

variables.label: Steps per color
variables.description: Banding: 1 gives hard bands, higher blends them.

variables.label: Scale
variables.description: Zooms the shader in or out.

variables.label: Resolution
variables.description: Share of the frame size the shader is drawn at, then scaled up. Lower renders faster; raise it when fine detail looks soft.
